logging.title: Event logging
logging.checking: Checking event logging on the printer…
logging.offText: Print Stats reads finished and cancelled prints from the printer's event log. Without it there's nothing to count.
logging.turnOnNote: This lasts until the printer restarts. To keep logging on, add this line to config.g:
logging.infoNote: Info level also logs messages from M117 and M291, so the log grows a little faster. Warning level is enough for Print Stats. To change it, edit the M929 line in config.g to S1.
logging.debugNote: Debug logs every message, so the log grows quickly and loads get slower. Warning level is enough for Print Stats. To change it, edit the M929 line in config.g to S1.

mode.title: Event log handling
mode.readOnlyText: The log file is never changed. The whole log is read each time it grows. Results are saved in 0:/sys/PrintStats/ and in this browser.
mode.manageText: When the printer is idle, the log is read in and started fresh. Updates become much quicker, because only the newest lines are downloaded.
mode.lossTitle: The original log text is not kept
mode.lossText: Print Stats keeps only what it counts: prints, print times, file names, power-ups, firmware versions, leveling and heater faults. Once a log has been read in, the file is deleted. That means:
mode.loss1: Other messages are gone, such as error and warning text, network and login lines, and macro or M118 messages.
mode.loss2: You can't open the full log later to troubleshoot a problem.
mode.loss3: A few lines logged in the second while the log is restarted may be missed.
mode.lossHint: Need the full log? Use read-only mode.
mode.lossShort: The original log text isn't kept after it's read in. Need the full log? Use read-only mode.

import.title: Older logs
import.text: Adds prints from an older or copied log. Prints already in the history aren't counted twice, so importing again is always safe.
import.none: No other log files in the system folder.
import.recordedNothing: Checked on {day}: already in the history
import.doneNothing: {file} has nothing the history doesn't already have.

history.title: History
history.recheckText: Reads the whole log again and adds anything missing. Nothing is removed.
